blocks.text: A wave that has already passed leaves a second outline behind the pet.
Appearance: Godot draws three translucent copies of the current pet frame in different directions. Reduced motion holds them still.
Care: Calm care, rest, and stress medicine.
Story connection: The repeated tide could expose a message absent from the first shoreline.

New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed game-background location derived from recurrence, Last Loops, and the game interface’s translation of deeper processes.
